name: local-workbench-macos-app
description: Thin macOS Electrobun shell around a local code-server backend.

scripts.build: bun run check:prereqs && bun run prepare:runtime && sh ./scripts/clean-build-target.sh stable && bun x electrobun build --env=stable && bun run stage:runtime:stable
scripts.build:dev: bun run check:prereqs && bun run prepare:runtime && sh ./scripts/clean-build-target.sh dev && bun x electrobun build --env=dev && bun run stage:runtime:dev
scripts.verify: bun run check:prereqs && bun run prepare:runtime && bun run typecheck
